detector_thread_decision: Eight detector threads improve idle medians but regress the CPU-contention replay. Six threads were also tested against four. Both are experiments, and four FP32 CPU detector threads remain the default.
method: Intel Core Ultra 5 125H, native Windows, warmed 2052x1128 source window, 100 ms source WGC cadence and a separate 16 ms WGC witness of the assistant. Each pair used both implementations in alternating order. A changed floor must register its new map. Inventory requires two newly clickable item rows to register in nonoverlapping locations absent before the source change. Whole-page settling overlaps frame selection. Medians of disjoint segments need not sum to the median endpoint. cpu_ms is process CPU time up through sampled Qt paint, not game FPS or CPU load.
source_chain: GameCapture Windows Graphics Capture and FrameBuffer.offer
PageOCR.detect_boxes, orientation classifier, sorted normalized recognition batches
Qt paint of new clickable items or changed floor
independent WGC registration of matching assistant pixels

paired_detector_with_cpu_contention.method: Four concurrent independent background processes repeatedly ran 20,000 SHA256 PBKDF2 iterations each. Work units per second cover the entire replay process, including initialization and witness processing. This is an artificial CPU contention check. Game FPS and player experience were not measured.

fp32_text_equivalence.exact_comparison: All ordered words, raw scores and quadrilateral coordinates serialized identically.

examples: A matched floor template on a node-detail page became insufficient.
The command resource present in the exploration reference was absent after quantization.
experimental_int8.reference: Differences against the normal FP32 reader, not independent manual ground truth. The calibration recording and native screenshots may share game content even with distinct normalized row bytes.

detector_preprocessing.method: Image resizing and lookup values use the same pinned provider. A single uint8 scratch plane supplies the model input one channel at a time. Warm single-image benchmark alternated the order across 18 calls per method for each shape; the first three per method were omitted. Every candidate tensor matched exactly.
detector_preprocessing.deployment: Not deployed. Less preprocessing work in isolation did not reliably improve first visible content. In the four-worker CPU contention comparison both endpoints regressed.

selected_positive_row_study.method: Counterfactual diagnostic only. Choose rows by the text already known from full inference. Time inference and decode of only those rows at the original normalized width, against all rows on the same image. Ground truth row locations, exclusion of overlays and page identity would still need independent current-frame verification for any real implementation. Missing anchor spellings and negative evidence were not recovered by this diagnostic. All named page facts remain with the ordinary reader.

validation.restored_suite_first_attempt: One earlier run of the same 91 checks raised KeyError life in test_map_updates_while_inventory_is_still_reading_then_replaces_same_frame. The isolated retry passed. The cause of the intermittent HUD timing failure is unverified.

deployment: Research batch. None of the investigated alternatives was enabled. The running test assistant was restarted from the original CPU/GPU source using its existing GPU flag. Private record digests matched across each replay and restart.

ui_profile.method: One separate instrumented map-phase iGPU replay of the planar-input candidate. Only the Qt sample handler and named map-refresh functions are reported, not work from overlapping recognition. Nested durations are inclusive and profiling affects timing. These figures are independent from the unprofiled paired medians.
